features.availability_rule: The 8h candle is available only when open_time + 8h is at or before decision_time.
features.lag: zero additional bars after the candle close
features.missing_rule: Require exact 8h adjacency; do not bridge or impute a missing candle.

features.availability_rule: Computed at each closed 8h timestamp from at least 12 eligible-symbol returns available at that timestamp.
features.missing_rule: Market return is missing when fewer than 12 eligible returns exist; dependent signals then fail closed.
features.source: cross-sectional median of causal close-to-close returns

features.availability_rule: Same timestamp as the coin and market returns after both are available.
features.missing_rule: Missing when either input is missing; no interpolation or cross-gap compression.
features.source: derived from close return and cross-sectional market return

features.availability_rule: All 6/18/63 exact adjacent residual observations must end at decision_time.
features.lag: windows end on the just-closed candle
features.missing_rule: Exclude the coin if any required residual is missing.
features.transform: window sum divided by root sum of squared residuals, then robust cross-sectional z score clipped to +/-4

features.availability_rule: All 63 common-market returns must be exactly adjacent and end at decision_time.
features.missing_rule: Request flat if any required common-market observation is missing.
features.transform: abs(sum returns) / sum(abs(returns)); linearly mapped from [0.12, 0.32] into trend share [0, 1]

features.availability_rule: Ranking occurs only after every component is causal at decision_time.
features.missing_rule: Request flat below 16 scored coins or score spread below 0.50.

forbidden_inputs: positions, fills, equity, PnL, or evaluator results
